title: 09/05/2025 - Software Updates
text:
## 09/05/2025 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105961
We made updates to several default widgets this week. If you customized any of these widgets and want to update them, you can find the latest code in the corresponding default widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, the latest updates will not be pushed to your website.
Updated the validation help text for the "Next Payment Due Date" field when editing member subscriptions on the Search Subscriptions page in the Admin.
Added the ability to upload .txt and .rtf files through the Media Manager in the Admin.
Updated the Manage Posts page in the Member Dashboard for Multi-Photo Post Types  to display the "created" and "end date" for posts when available. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums datatable
Fixed an issue that prevented the system from properly auto-matching members with leads based on the lead's submitted location in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap - Contact Member Lead Map
Fixed an issue that caused the Lead Form in the Hero Content on the homepage to display too wide in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Show Lead Form
Fixed an issue that prevented the Member Limit from being enforced as expected on member signup pages in some cases.
Fixed an issue that prevented the system from respecting the "Require Credit Card When $0.00?" Coupon Code setting after applying a 100% discount coupon on the frontend.
Fixed an issue that prevented the canonical link from working properly when visiting a Membership Plan Search Results page. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD
Fixed an issue that prevented the system from matching members with direct leads when the Automatic Lead Matching Add-On was disabled.
Updated the validation for required fields when applying a 100% discount coupon on checkout pages.
